title: Responsive Web Design using Flexbox
outcome: This course will help you to develop responsive layouts using CSS Flexbox and CSS Media Queries.
why: Flexbox is a powerful tool for creating responsive layouts that look good on any device
Responsive design helps ensure that users have a seamless and enjoyable experience no matter what device they are using to access your site
Learning responsive web design using Flexbox help you create better, more user-friendly websites
